This is my own small maize plot, and it is not big, so I will manage it with what my household can afford and do by ourselves. I will intercrop and use the seed I can save or get locally, and I will rely more on family work than paying for many inputs. I do not expect to irrigate because I depend on the rains, and I will only use simple inputs that are within my means.
